svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bought plain 25.4 mm steel post with a top saddle clamp, cut to 280.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stop slot on the right (chain) side: 6 wide, from 90 to 236 up from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Chain drill 6 mm along a scribed line, file straight, ends square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The slot lies on the side of the post, where fore-and-aft bending

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stress is lowest; it lowers the post's stiffness by under 1 %.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Scribe the minimum insertion mark all round, 100 up from the bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: slides in the sleeve, slot to the right; the sleeve collar's stop

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screw rides in it. 100 stays inside the sleeve at the top stop.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the slot is straight along the post (the saddle stays

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pointing forward because the screw keys it).
